'''Tittus''', also known as '''Tittus the Destroyer''', was the name given to a massive [[Geo Beast]] living in the [[Nightmare Lands]] on [[Voss]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Along with several other colossal creatures that roamed Voss, Tittus the Destroyer was targeted by hunters.<ref name="Voss">{{TORcite|type=other|Achievement: Champion of Voss}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics}}
Around [[3640 BBY]], the Geo Beast wandered off to the [[Walk of the Masters]], where a hunter [[Death/Legends|killed]] it.<ref name="Voss" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tittus appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Voss]]. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed by characters of both factions for loot and as part of the achievement.<ref name="Voss" />
